scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n API,WEB -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @campanha/api" "npm run dev -w @campanha/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @campanha/types && npm run build -w @campanha/validation && npm run build -w @campanha/database && npm run build -w @campanha/api && npm run build -w @campanha/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @campanha/types && npm run build -w @campanha/validation && npm run build -w @campanha/database
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
